$comment: The canonical, verified stack (DECISIONS.md section 2). Skills cite these versions; node tools/check-stack-pins.mjs fails on a skill that states a different one. Each entry: version (what a fresh install resolves on the verified date), range (statements of this version that count as consistent: Expo's own specifier for SDK-bundled packages, the exact pin otherwise), spec (the package.json specifier skills write), names (how prose names it), how it was verified, and the command that re-verifies it. Refresh the whole table when Expo SDK 58 lands.

sources.expoBundled: node_modules/expo/bundledNativeModules.json of a fresh create-expo-app (expo 57.0.26) app, read 2026-10-03; refreshed 2026-10-17 from node_modules/expo/bundledNativeModules.json of expo 57.0.27 in tools/harness (the newest SDK 57 patch past the 7-day release age; 57.0.26 to 57.0.27 moves only patch specifiers of Expo modules)
sources.expoTemplate: package.json of the same fresh create-expo-app SDK 57 app
sources.npm: npm view <package> version / npm view <package>@<range> version, run 2026-10-03 with npm 11.17
sources.sourceApp: cross-checked with the versions table of the production app the skills were generalized from (verified 2026-09-26)

releaseAgeNote: published is the npm publish date of version. A version younger than releaseAgeDays on the verified date installs under a min-release-age=7 policy only from published + 7 days (or with a dated exclude); dependency-management owns that policy.

expo.how: npx expo install --check in tools/harness on 2026-10-17: expo 57.0.30 (published 2026-10-15) is the newest SDK 57 patch and becomes installable under min-release-age=7 on 2026-10-23; 57.0.27 (2026-10-06) is the newest one past the release age, installed with npx expo install expo@~57.0.27 together with its bundledNativeModules.json specifiers; npm dist-tag latest = 57.0.30. 57.0.26 stays accepted: it was verified 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-16 and differs from 57.0.27 only in patch specifiers
expo.reverify: npx expo install --check (in tools/harness); npm view expo@~57.0.27 version

policy: Versions are what tools/harness installs on the verified date under a 7-day minimum release age (npm min-release-age). Expo SDK runtime packages keep the ~ specifier npx expo install writes; dev tools in the Expo map (typescript, jest, jest-expo) are pinned exactly inside Expo range; packages outside the Expo map are pinned exactly.
